name: build-flutter-apps
description: Build Flutter apps with workflows for Dart setup, adaptive UI, architecture, native integrations, browser previews, testing, debugging, DevTools profiling, and memory investigation.

interface.shortDescription: Build, preview, test, profile, and debug Flutter apps with Dart, DevTools, and native workflows
interface.longDescription: Use Build Flutter Apps to set up current Flutter and Dart projects, build adaptive multi-platform UI, structure app architecture, refactor widget trees, preview Flutter apps inside the visible Codex side-panel browser with a browser-first workflow, add deep links and type-safe native integrations, test apps and plugins, audit runtime performance, analyze DevTools traces, investigate memory leaks, and debug apps on selected Flutter targets.
defaultPrompt: Build, preview, or debug a Flutter app with Dart, adaptive widgets, testing, and DevTools.
